discord: ARC-AGI-2 evening: ARC Raiders logged an observed jump from ninth to seventh, reaching 58.75. Tufa Labs leads at 83.61, ahead of rabbithole at 80.56; Yi-Chia Chen and nvbanana are close in third and fourth. There is no usable prior-evening baseline, so these are not full-day changes. headline: ARC Raiders climb to seventh as Tufa Labs heads ARC-AGI-2 field

sections.heading: The move in the top ten
sections.text: ARC Raiders registered a score event from 47.22 to 58.75, moving from ninth to seventh in that observation. It remained seventh at the latest snapshot, just ahead of Dawid Kopiczko at 58.47. _hans also logged a rise from 60.42 to 64.58 in the observed events and stands sixth. These are observed score events; without a usable prior-evening baseline, they are not certified net daily gains.

sections.heading: The leaders at the bell
sections.text: Tufa Labs tops the public board at 83.61, followed by rabbithole at 80.56. Yi-Chia Chen is third at 77.22, narrowly ahead of nvbanana at 77.08. ALbert RUehlman holds fifth at 66.81. The top four are separated by 6.53 points, while the seventh and eighth places are separated by 0.28.

sections.heading: The wider field
sections.text: Majkel1337 is ninth at 48.33 and Khaotic Sethesis tenth at 45.83. Beyond the top ten, Mark Barney is 572nd at 30.97, Son Pham 800th at 30.14, and Jan Disselhoff 1,641st at 14.17. The feed has no usable observation at the previous day’s 6 p.m. Eastern baseline, so today’s edition cannot say how those standings changed over the full interval. Public medal bands remain provisional.
